random.description: This is a photomicrograph of spleen tissue stained with H&E. The image shows prominent red pulp congestion with hemorrhage alongside cellular infiltrates. Numerous inclusion-bearing cells and characteristic viral changes are present within the splenic parenchyma. The histopathological findings are consistent with cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection of the spleen.
